definition.name: AWS access key
definition.remediation: Deactivate this key in AWS IAM, create a new one, and load it from a secret manager or environment variable instead of the file.

definition.name: GitHub token
definition.remediation: Revoke this token in GitHub settings and create a new one with only the scopes it needs.

definition.name: Private key block
definition.remediation: Treat this key as compromised: replace it, revoke the old one, and keep private keys in a key store or secret manager.

definition.name: Secret-looking assignment
definition.remediation: If this is a real secret, rotate it and load it from a secret manager or environment variable instead of the file.

definition.name: Secret written to a log
definition.remediation: Remove the secret from this log call, or log a fixed placeholder such as "[redacted]" instead.
